import pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
ready=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
child_request=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
child_done=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3])
child_pid=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[4])
exit_request=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[5])
ready.write_text('ready',encoding='utf-8')
while not exit_request.exists():
 if child_request.exists() and not child_done.exists():
  child=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c','import time; time.sleep(3600)'],stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,creationflags=getattr(subprocess,'CREATE_NO_WINDOW',0))
  child_pid.write_text(str(child.pid),encoding='ascii')
  child_done.write_text('done',encoding='ascii')
 time.sleep(0.02)
